# V7 P7.2 — MongoDB Index Report

**Generated by:** Account 2 (Engine)
**Date:** V7 Sprint
**Script:** `scripts/mongo-indexes.js` (idempotent — safe to re-run)
**Status:** COMPLETE

---

## Overview

This report documents every MongoDB index declared in `scripts/mongo-indexes.js`,
the query patterns each index serves, and the audit of all collections introduced
in P4–P6 (AI Engine v2, God-Mode Matrix, Package Manager, Completeness Sweep).

The index creation script is **idempotent**: MongoDB `createIndex()` is a no-op if
the index already exists. Running the script multiple times is safe.

---

| Index Name | Spec | Options | Serves Query |

> **Note:** The `UserPackage` schema in `src/lib/packages/manager.js` already
> declares `userId: { unique: true, index: true }` at the schema level. The
> explicit index here ensures visibility in the inventory and is idempotent
> (MongoDB deduplicates by name).

### 11. `featuretoggles` (0 additional indexes) — **P5.1 NEW**

The `FeatureToggle` model (`models/featureToggle.js`) is a **singleton document**
— one record holds the entire toggle map. All access is via `getOrCreate()` which
uses the `_id` lookup. No additional query indexes are required. Declared in the
inventory for completeness.

## TTL Strategy (ephemeral data)

| Collection | TTL Field | Expiry | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliveryreports` | `sentAt` | 30 days | Delivery logs are operational; stale logs auto-purged |
| `tag_maps` | `createdAt` | 30 days | Tag mappings are per-campaign; old campaigns' tags expire |
| `routing_audits` | `createdAt` | 30 days | Audit trail for debugging; 30-day retention is sufficient |

All other collections contain persistent business data (users, campaigns,
accounts, packages, toggles) and do not use TTL.

---

## P4–P6 Collection Audit

The following modules were introduced in P4–P6. Each was audited for missing
indexes:

| Module | Phase | Collection(s) | Index Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI Engine v2 (engine.js) | P4 | None (Redis-only pools) | N/A — pools use Redis ZSETs, not MongoDB |
| Restock Worker (restockWorker.js) | P4 | None (Redis-only) | N/A — restock state in Redis keys |
| Auto-Fill (autoFill.js) | P4 | None (Redis-only) | N/A — quota state in Redis |
| Toggle Registry (registry.js) | P5.1 | `featuretoggles` | Singleton — no indexes needed |
| Package Manager (manager.js) | P5.2 | `userpackages` | ✓ Indexed (userId unique + packageName) |
| Validator Pipeline (pipeline.js) | P6.1 | None (Redis-only dedup) | N/A — dedup set in Redis SADD |
| Sandbox Isolation (isolation.js) | P6.2 | None (Redis-only) | N/A — sandbox state in Redis keys (7-day TTL) |
| SendGuard Resilience (sendGuard.js) | P6.3 | None (Redis-only) | N/A — campaign state in Redis keys |
| i18n + UX Helpers | P6.4 | None (pure functions) | N/A — no persistence |
| Observability (health/metrics) | P7.1 | None (Redis-only) | N/A — metrics in Redis ZSETs |

**Conclusion:** The only new MongoDB collection from P4–P6 is `userpackages`,
which is fully indexed. All other P4–P6 modules use Redis for ephemeral state
(with appropriate TTLs) or are pure functions with no persistence layer.

---

## How to Run

```bash
# Set MongoDB URI (or use existing env)
export MONGODB_URI="mongodb+srv://..."
export MONGODB_DB="mms_sender"  # optional, defaults to mms_sender

# Run the idempotent index creation script
node scripts/mongo-indexes.js
```

**Expected output:** All indexes created or skipped (already exist). Exit code 0.
The script prints a full index inventory per collection at the end for verification.
